reranked.question: Will renaming an identical file create a second searchable document?
reranked.answer: Within a workspace, identical document bytes share a content hash. Uploading the same bytes with a different filename does not create a second searchable copy. Changing the content creates a new document version. The same file uploaded to another workspace is indexed separately because workspaces do not share search indexes.

reranked.question: How can I check whether an ingestion job has finished?
